correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md proves coefficient-ideal equivalence using F(q)=(1-q)^(-1)F(q^m), three U_m selections and T(q) with an integral power-series inverse and constant 1. The explicit K_3(n)=m^6*C(n+2,3)+B*C(n+1,2)+Cn is an integer-valued cubic with binomial-basis coefficient gcd determined by n=1,2,3. For p>=5, v_p(C)=3v_p(m); for p=2 the relevant exponent is 3v_2(m)-2; for p=3 the exact modulo-9 branch criterion caps the possible extra factor at one 3. Every m>=2 and (a,b) in {0,1}² is handled; the arguments m^4n-m-am²-bm³ are nonnegative. Independently regenerated both full coin-change and four-power truncated counts for m=2..12 (44 base-branch cases); verified individual truncated polynomial values and first-three actual full-sequence gcds. The full partition values need NOT equal K_3 coefficients termwise: their gcd ideals agree via convolution with T.
